name: customer-eval
description: Evaluate invoice extraction with one fixed prompt on two models, locally or in AgentCore, and inspect quality, cost and latency.

interface.shortDescription: Compare invoice quality, cost and latency
interface.longDescription: Start with invoice extraction from OCR text. Review a recorded local and AgentCore comparison, agree what correctness means, then run one fixed prompt on two models and inspect the resulting HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Show the recorded invoice comparison and its AWS architecture.
Help me decide which invoice errors matter before preparing an evaluation.
Run my prepared invoice study locally and on AgentCore.
